newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Electrolux eyes Raytheon unit buy - paper.
newsitem.headline: Electrolux eyes Raytheon unit buy - paper.

text.p: Electrolux AB said on Monday it was interested in U.S. acquisitions if the price was right, and noted that the white goods division of Raytheon, which is up for sale, may complement the Swedish appliance maker very well, Svenska Dagbladet reported on Monday.
"A purchase is always on the agenda if the price is right," Michael Treschow, the new managing director of Electrolux AB, was quoted as telling the newspaper in an interview.
Treschow declined to comment on whether Electrolux had put an application in to buy the Raytheon division, but noted a good fit between the two firms.
"Raytheon has both white goods as well as commercial equipment that would complement us well," the newspaper quoted Treschow as saying.
Treschow said the U.S. white goods market was beginning to produce a profit for the company.
"We are now beginning to see that's it's possible to make money on appliances in the United States. It feels like we are in a positive trend," he told the newspaper.
Asked if the company had swung to profit for its U.S. white goods division, he said yes.
"For single months, but I don't want to say if we are there yet. If we make it for the full-year I will be satisfied. Then we will have passed a milestone," the newspaper quoted him as saying.
"I think the United States is going to continue at a good historical level. We also see signs of improvement in Europe. If this is a trend or sporadic upturns -- it's too early to tell," he said.
"But it has felt a little more positive in the latest months," he added.
The biggest problem for Electrolux is the Commercial Appliances division, Treschow said.
"If people do a basic analysis by looking at the figures, the trend for the business area Commercial Appliances is bad. There we really have to set to work," he told the newspaper.
He said the catering section, Food Service, was experiencing the most difficulties.
